Instructions: SETUP: bead calibration (docs/BEAD_CALIBRATION.md). The Cd tests are done. Order: ONE capture per single-size sandwich at its best focus, biggest to smallest (the background comes from the same photo), then the MIXED one through focus (optional, if it works), then the falling beads in PCC. EMPTY or DISCONNECT the silicone line (the traverse moves 0.5 mm per capture so the auto-trigger fires) and HOME the traverse first (18 mm of nudges in all; the board homed at 09:18, so no need again). Move the nozzle out of the way as needed, but do NOT touch the camera, lens (focus ring, aperture), its distance or the backlight. Exposure 4 us (the standard). Camera tab: Run AI analysis OFF, Window check OFF, Auto-trigger ON. Mount the 155.8 um sandwich (coverslip towards the camera) square to the camera at the spray plane. Find ITS best focus with the micrometer and capture. One capture per slide.

SETUP: the MIXED sandwich (all five sizes), OPTIONAL, after the single-size ones; skip all the mixed rows if it does not work. It gives the depth of field per size. Same rules: do NOT touch the camera, lens, its distance or the backlight. Mount the MIXED sandwich (all five sizes, coverslip towards the camera) square to the camera at the spray plane. Find best focus on the 155.8 um beads with the micrometer: that reading is z0 (write it down). Then turn back a little past z0 - 8.00 mm (e.g. -8.5, or as far as the stage goes) and forward to z0 - 8.00 mm, so the backlash is taken up.
